objective_for_doctor:
Age: 57
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have swelling in one or more areas of your body, swelling (right ankle), and swelling (left ankle)

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi doctor. I’m here because I have swelling in both ankles, and also swelling up into my thighs (right more than left). I feel pain around it—more like a tugging pain—and it’s about 4/10, starting fairly quickly (around 3/10 in speed).

I’m sorry you’re dealing with that. **One question at a time**:

**1) When did the swelling start—how many hours/days ago—and has it been getting steadily worse, improving, or coming and going?**
It started recently—within the last day. It’s been getting steadily worse since it began, not really coming and going.
**2) Is the swelling pitting when you press a finger into the ankle/shin for ~5 seconds (does it leave an indentation)?**
Yes, I think it’s pitting—when I press for a few seconds, it leaves an indentation.
**3) Do you have any shortness of breath, chest pain, or trouble lying flat at night?**
No, I don’t have shortness of breath, chest pain, or trouble lying flat.
**4) Any fever, chills, or feeling sick/ill recently?**
No fever or chills. I haven’t felt sick or ill recently.
**5) Have you noticed swelling anywhere else—especially your face/lips/tongue, one arm, or generalized body swelling?**
It’s mainly both ankles, and swelling goes up into both thighs (right more than left). I haven’t noticed face/lip/tongue swelling, and I don’t think it’s one arm only.
**6) Any recent long travel or being bedridden, recent surgery, or a history of blood clots?**
No recent long travel and I haven’t been bedridden. I do have a history of blood clots.
**7) Are you currently on blood thinners (anticoagulation), and if so which one and do you take it consistently?**
No, I’m not currently on blood thinners. I’m not taking any anticoagulation consistently—because I’m not on them.
**8) Do you have any new/worsening leg pain in one calf more than the other, or pain when you walk/press along the calf?**
Yes, I have pain related to the swelling. It feels more on the right side, including the right ankle and right lateral foot, and it also goes into the thighs—so the right feels worse than the left.
**9) Is the right leg swelling clearly more than the left (for example, one calf noticeably larger), or is it fairly symmetric?**
It’s not perfectly symmetric—right is clearly more than left. The right ankle and right thigh are more swollen.
**10) Any redness, warmth, or skin discoloration over the swollen areas?**
I haven’t noticed redness or warmth over the swollen areas, and I don’t think there’s skin discoloration.
**11) Any recent injury, new medications, or changes in diet (including lots of salt), or new kidney/liver/heart problems you’ve been told about?**
I haven’t had an injury. I have been taking anti-inflammatory drugs recently. I don’t know about any new kidney problems. I do have liver cirrhosis and heart failure.
**12) With your heart failure, do you know if you’ve had recent worsening—like needing more pillows to sleep, waking up short of breath, or reduced urine output?**
I don’t have shortness of breath or need more pillows. I’m not sure about urine output changes.
**13) Are you on any diuretics (like furosemide/Lasix, bumetanide), and if so have you missed doses or had them changed recently?**
I’m not sure—I'm not taking or I don’t know if I’m on diuretics. I haven’t missed doses that I know of.
**14) Any history of liver disease complications like ascites, or have you noticed abdominal swelling or easy bruising/bleeding?**
I do have liver cirrhosis. I haven’t noticed abdominal swelling, and I don’t think I have easy bruising or bleeding.
